name: 活动绳直段与转弯候选 A1
selection: Unchanged pre-existing fixed QA38; all400 remains denominator
allowed_inputs: Only manifest400 original PNG plus frozen C3/C4 automatic predictions
revision_policy: Each round in new directory with code snapshot; never overwrite failed predictions. Stop branch when no independently observed net gain; no ranking network training.
final_policy: Select and freeze one source set after fixed38 inspection, then apply once to all400. Rendering/integrity fixes documented separately.

acceptance.execution: 38/38 before full400, finite coordinates and same original frame; original/source hashes unchanged
acceptance.image_evidence: Inspect fixed QA including failures and near ties, compare with unmodified original; report observed wrong paths even when formal identity is unscorable
acceptance.contact: No physical contact acceptance without independent evidence; projected straight-to-curve change only image transition candidate
acceptance.selection: No automatic not_detected treated as verified absence; selected/uncertain/not_detected all retained
acceptance.no_success_by_abstention: Report output coverage alongside rejection; all unknown is not a successful contact detector
acceptance.stop: Maximum3 core rounds or no concrete improvement, whichever comes first; retain unresolved failures in final results

truth_isolation: Any matching open reference labels only in independent evaluator after saved predictions, never in algorithm inputs
known_roi_risk: C4 SAM union masks can include gloves/tools or miss dark winding surface; automatic semantic proposals are not truth
